localizedValues.name: PS-1
localizedValues.description:
The picnic shelter is a log structure with a cement floor and wood stove. It is situated in a large grassy day use which is equipped with a playground for children. There is no designated group parking but a day use parking lot is available to accommodate up to 8 vehicles. It is strongly encouraged that large groups carpool as there is very limited space for parking and no alternative parking options. The picnic shelter can comfortably accommodate 36 occupants, while the park has a maximum occupancy of 60 set for events.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
